prerequisites: THE STUDENT SHOULD KNOW THE PRINCIPLES OF THE APPLIED THERMODYNAMICS, HEAT TRANSFER AND ENERGETICS.

learning_outcomes.text: Gain knowledge of the indoor environmental quality which is one of the main requirements prescribed by the European Directive on energy efficiency in buildings and one of the main goals of sustainable development, based on thermodynamics and heat transfer fundamentals.

Gain knowledge of the basic principles of the indoor environmental quality design in terms of thermal comfort and indoor air quality, which are crucial issues of HVAC design according to recent normative development.
Learn European standards and Italian laws related to the design of the indoor environmental quality.
Be trained to work in groups and to discuss topics related to the energy design of the building envelope.
Be able to apply the acquired knowledge to different contexts and to deepen the topics using materials other than those proposed.

syllabus_topics: APPLIED THERMODYNAMICS AND HEAT TRANSFER FUNDAMENTALS (4 H)
THERMAL COMFORT: HEAT BALANCE ON THE HUMAN BODY, GLOBAL COMFORT AND LOCAL DISCOMFORT INDICES, MEASUREMENTS METHODS AND INSTRUMENTS, STANDARDS (13 H)

INDOOR AIR QUALITY: POLLUTANTS, STANDARDIZATION IN THE FIELD, INDOOR AND OUTDOOR AIR QUALITY, MEASUREMENT AND ASSESSMENT OF THE INDOOR AIR QUALITY, METHODS FOR THE ENHANCEMENT OF THE INDOOR AIR QUALITY, STANDARDS AND LAWS (15 H)
FUNDAMENTALS OF VENTILATION OF INDOOR ENVIRONMENTS (6 H)
MODELS FOR THE EVALUATION OF THE INFECTION RISK IN INDOOR ENVIRONMENTS (5 H)
A CASE STUDY: ENVIRONMENTS FOR THE PRESERVATION OF THE CULTURAL HERITAGE (5H)

assessment_methods.method: Oral exam (discussion of a design exercise and main course topics)

assessment_rules: The assessment is based on an oral exam. To pass, the student must demonstrate understanding and application of the main concepts. For excellence, the student must show wide maturity in course content and high ability of exposure and synthesis.
